Gastroenterology Marketing in Houston: Website & Visibility Audits for GI Practices

Houston is our home market, and our gastroenterology slot here is already taken. We represent one GI practice in Houston and listed surrounding GI territories, so we do not take on a competing practice for ongoing marketing. What we can offer any Houston GI practice is a complimentary website and visibility audit, walked through with you on a video call, that your own team or current agency can act on.

Ongoing GI marketing is not available in Houston, including the listed GI territories of Cypress, Katy and Sugar Land. This page offers a complimentary audit and consultation only. It is not a waiting list or a paid exception.
Request a complimentary GI website audit
Call (832) 266-7209
  • Houston-based since 2013
  • 1,000+ websites repaired
  • No obligation
  • Findings are yours to keep
  • Houston GI issues
  • Audit scope

What we see in Houston GI

Why Houston GI practices ask for an outside review

The Houston gastroenterology market has consolidated. Large multi-office groups and practice platforms now operate across the metro, with brand sites that list dozens of physicians and locations. Independent and mid-size practices compete with that scale on the same search results and Maps listings. An audit helps you see where your own website and listings fall short before you spend more on ads or a redesign.

Office listings drift

Practices with offices across Houston, Pearland or the Bay Area often have Maps profiles with old hours, merged locations or the wrong landing page.

Physicians lack context

Profiles name the doctor but not the offices, endoscopy center or clinics they cover, so patients choose by distance alone.

Referral steps are hidden

Primary care offices across a large metro need a fax number, portal link and document checklist that they can find in seconds.

Questions the audit answers

  1. Can patients find you?Maps and search presence by office
  2. Do they understand you?Physician, procedure and office clarity
  3. Can they contact you?Forms, calls and referral instructions
  4. Can you measure it?Tracking of calls and requests
  5. What first?A short, ordered list of fixes

Audit scope

What the complimentary Houston GI audit includes

This is the service currently available to Houston gastroenterology practices. It is a diagnostic, not an implementation project, and it does not lead to an ongoing retainer in this territory.

Technical website check

Speed, mobile layout, crawl errors, broken links and forms, and how the site handles multiple offices.

Local listing review

Google Business Profiles for each office: categories, hours, landing pages, photos and review patterns.

Physician and procedure pages

Whether each physician, office and core procedure has a clear, accurate page, and where content is thin or duplicated.

Referral and contact paths

How easily a patient or referring office can call, request an appointment or send records.

Tracking check

Whether calls, forms and referral actions are measured separately in your current analytics.

Written priority list

A short report ranking issues by impact and effort, discussed with you on a video call.

What is not included: ongoing SEO, Google Ads management or content production for Houston GI practices. If you need implementation, your in-house team, IT vendor or another agency can use the findings. For background on what ongoing GI work involves elsewhere, see our gastroenterology marketing overview.

Process

How the audit works

The audit follows the first two stages of our usual process, assess and prioritize, and stops there. You decide what happens next.

  1. Request

    Send your practice name, website, offices and ZIP codes through the form. We confirm the audit, not a sales call.

  2. Assess

    We review your public website and listings. If you share analytics or Search Console access, we include it; otherwise we say what we could not see.

  3. Prioritize

    We rank findings by likely effect on contacts and referrals, and by effort.

  4. Walk-through

    A video call with your administrator or physician lead to go through the findings and answer questions.

  5. Hand-off

    You keep the written findings. We do not follow up with ongoing-service offers in a reserved territory.

Illustrative finding format

Example of how findings are written

Not a real Houston client.

  • Issue: Pearland office profile links to the homepage.
  • Why it matters: visitors from that listing must search again for hours and directions.
  • Fix: create an office page and update the profile link.
  • Effort: low. Owner: your web team.

The audit reports what we observe. It does not estimate patient volume or revenue.

Availability and local findings

Houston GI availability, coverage and what we observed

We are based in Houston. Gastroenterology is reserved for an existing client in Houston and listed surrounding GI territories, including Cypress, Katy and Sugar Land. A ZIP code missing from that list is not automatically open; we confirm each request individually.

Reserved

Ongoing GI marketing

Not available in Houston and the listed GI territories. We will not take on a competing GI practice in protected ZIP codes.

Available

Complimentary audit and consultation

Available to Houston GI practices with no obligation. One audit per practice; findings are yours.

Other services

Emergency website repair

If your website is down or broken, our website repair team can help regardless of marketing territory.

Website repair services

Local search notes (reviewed 6 November 2026)

We searched agency-buyer phrases such as ‘gastroenterology marketing agency Houston’ and reviewed the patient-side landscape. Agency results were dominated by national healthcare marketing firms with city-specific landing pages rather than Houston-based teams. On the patient side, multi-office GI groups and practice platforms have expanded across the metro through partnerships and acquisitions. These are qualitative observations from public results, not search-volume or ranking data.

Looking for broader Houston healthcare marketing? See our medical SEO in Houston page and the Texas healthcare marketing hub.

Questions and audit request

Houston GI audit questions

Clear answers about availability and what you receive.

Is ongoing GI marketing available in our Houston ZIP code?

Not in Houston or the listed surrounding GI territories, including Cypress, Katy and Sugar Land. We represent one gastroenterology practice there and do not take on a competing practice in protected ZIP codes. If your offices are outside those areas, send the addresses and we will check them individually, but please do not assume an unlisted ZIP code is open.

Can we request a complimentary audit if the territory is reserved?

Yes. That is exactly what this page offers. The audit and video consultation are free, carry no obligation and are not a route into a paid exception or waiting list.

What does the gastroenterology website audit cover?

Technical health, Google Business Profiles for each office, physician, office and procedure pages, referral and contact paths, and whether calls and forms are tracked. You receive a written priority list and a walk-through call.

Who can act on the findings?

Your in-house coordinator, IT or website vendor, or another agency. Findings are written so a competent web team can implement them without us.

Do you need access to our analytics or Google accounts?

No. We can audit public information alone. If you choose to share read-only analytics or Search Console access, we include it and say clearly which findings rely on it.

Will you contact our patients or physicians?

No. The audit reviews your website and listings only. Please do not send patient information through the form.

Request a Houston GI website audit

Complimentary and without obligation. Ongoing GI marketing is not available in this territory.
